hypothesis: E16 attempt 2's first-policy mismatch is ordinary harness startup nondeterminism rather than a hidden side effect of the component-axis flag. Two identical world-axis controls will differ at first policy at least as materially as the world/component pair, while all arms converge to the same active-standing input and first-active canonical actions.
single_changed_variable: Only arm B adds -PhysAnimExperimentalComponentActionAxis; A1 and A2 are identical repeats.

classification.startup_nondeterminism_supported: A1/A2 first-policy snapshots or actions differ materially, with active-standing input/action captures equal across A1/A2/B.
classification.hidden_flag_side_effect_supported: A1/A2 first-policy captures are exact but B differs before active standing.
classification.inconclusive: Active-standing pre-intervention captures fail to converge or artifacts are incomplete.

next_if_startup_nondeterminism: Replace the nondeterministic first-policy cross-run gate with deterministic same-state action replay or an in-process counterfactual at the first active-standing write, then evaluate captured-neutral and frame choices without closed-loop divergence.
next_if_hidden_side_effect: Add configured/effective axis-mode chronology at every policy target write and isolate the command-line side effect before any further behavioral experiment.
